title: ID0432036-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / PD 170001363] Screen Adjustment on charging station
description:
Reported issue: On Wednesday 11/06, I created a ticket (ID0430464) to adjust the position of charger - dispenser on the Sicharge D screen. This would have been adjusted, however a technician was on site today and found that this was not the case.
Please use the following order on the screen: left Sicharge D: plug1 - plug 2. Right Dispenser: plug 3 - plug 4. I have attached pictures.
Also the LED strip of plug 1 is red while the plug on the screen shows no error message and one can charge as usual. Please do the necessary for this.
Solution:

additional_info.body:
Dear Chloë D'hose,
I hope this message finds you well.
Following the changes implemented as per your request yesterday, we observed that the charger is currently offline on the SCB platform. Additionally, we noticed that you have raised a new support ticket today (Case #0433088) regarding all outlets being disabled.
To proceed with troubleshooting, we kindly request you to attempt a reboot of the charger. If the charger has an active OCPP connection, a remote reboot may be possible. Alternatively, if feasible, please try rebooting the charger manually on-site.
Once the charger is back online on SCB, we will be able to remotely investigate and resolve the issue related to the disabled outlets. If a reboot is not possible from your end, we may need to arrange a site visit to restore connectivity and address the issue accordingly.
Please let us know how you would like to proceed.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar
